name: Three-key, Material-mappable
premise: Primary, secondary and tertiary key colours, each with container and on- pairs -- the structural shape Material 3 actually ships (confirmed: 26 total roles, 3 base + 5 container + 2 dim/bright surface roles among them). A future Android product built on these tokens needs no invented mapping, and the role-naming question (this rebuild's own bg vs surface question) resolves itself because the roles come from the source structure. The cost: more roles than a solo studio brand strictly needs, and a look that is partly Google's rather than distinctively GRU953's.

ground.label: Primary
ground.note: Kept as Meridian, playing Material's 'primary' role.

accent_light.label: Secondary (light)
accent_light.note: Daybreak's light value, playing Material's 'secondary' role.

support.label: Tertiary
support.note: A genuinely new third key colour -- Material's structure requires three, and reusing Ember here would collapse the tertiary/support distinction the direction exists to test.
